(U3) u vanishes to EVEN order 2 in (q-1) while a bar-odd carrier vanishes to ODD order, so bar-odd fibre content cannot map to real u-power coefficients. Net: the odd channel enters through the ARCHIMEDEAN EVALUATION map (tau-functor / Markov pairing at Vol=1; owner 2026-06-16), NOT a fibre basis change. The naive re-expansion route is excluded as the descent mechanism; KC15/KC16 ingredients are NOT excluded. NO c_k value; nothing wired.
